name: Limit Windows Update Download Bandwidth
description: Limits the bandwidth Windows Update and Delivery Optimization can use for downloads to reduce network interruptions during gaming or streaming.

description_i18n.en: Limits the bandwidth Windows Update and Delivery Optimization can use for downloads to reduce network interruptions during gaming or streaming.
description_i18n.de: Begrenzt die Bandbreite, die Windows Update und Delivery Optimization für Downloads verwenden dürfen, um Netzwerkunterbrechungen während des Gamings oder Streamings zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Limite la bande passante que Windows Update et l'optimisation de livraison peuvent utiliser pour les téléchargements afin de réduire les interruptions réseau pendant le jeu ou le streaming.

warnings.title: Update speed impact
warnings.message: Very low limits can make Windows updates download much slower. Enterprise, domain, or MDM policies may override these settings

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Uses Delivery Optimization percentage bandwidth policy values supported on Windows 10 version 1803 and later, and Windows 11.

technical_details: Configures Delivery Optimization policy values under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization The selected preset writes DOPercentageMaxBackgroundBandwidth and DOPercentageMaxForegroundBandwidth as percentage-based bandwidth limits
